mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior three months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% for two consecutive months, it signals monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer spending and housing market strength, which together signal elevated corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint growth in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), a further decline in unemployment signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with UNRATE < 3.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior three months indicates expanding manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 108.0 for two consecutive months, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profitability and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods with INDPRO < 108.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that elevates consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in UNRATE and increase in PAYEMS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term coefficient is negative with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) growth exceeds 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals strong consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods with RSAFS growth > 0.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
